title: DeepSeek Harness with a local model
description: DeepSeek Harness with a model on your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM or another OpenAI-compatible one) and nothing else: only the server's address is opened, the provider's hosts stay closed, and the loop guard keeps a small model from going round in circles.

de.title: DeepSeek Harness mit einem lokalen Modell
de.description: DeepSeek Harness mit einem Modell auf Ihrem eigenen Server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM oder ein anderer OpenAI-kompatibler) und sonst nichts: nur die Adresse des Servers ist offen, die Hosts des Anbieters bleiben zu, und der Schleifenschutz hält ein kleines Modell davon ab, sich im Kreis zu drehen.

llm.label: LLM server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

notes: Register the server once: sandbox-ai llm add NAME --kind ollama|lmstudio|llamacpp|vllm|openai-compatible --url URL --model MODEL; sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent dsh asks it for the API DeepSeek Harness uses.

DeepSeek Harness gets the server as a route of its own (OpenAI chat completions at the server's /v1) and as its default model in its read-only patch (/etc/dsh/sandbox-ai.patch.yml), the key as a placeholder the connection proxy replaces, the loop guard's instructions in its system prompt.

The relay sets the model's parameters (sandbox-ai llm params) and the loop guard on the wire, the same for every agent. Agents need a model with tool calls and a long context (qwen3-coder, gpt-oss, ...; Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 or more). On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman.

DeepSeek Harness talks in the terminal: sandbox-ai's chat (its release has none of its own), each message one run of its headless mode, one conversation kept by its session id (/help lists the commands, Ctrl+C cancels an answer). Approvals cannot be answered in the chat: an action it would ask about is refused (with -D it asks nothing). Add --browser (the app: the Board's Browser part; Podman) and its web UI opens as well, in the session browser beside the terminal, where it asks you; -- web: the web UI alone. One task: sandbox-ai dsh -- headless "TASK".
Its image first: sandbox-ai build dsh.
